note: Frozen before the holdout (2024-01-01 .. 2026-10-31) was read by any rule, selector or detector. Do not edit; a change needs frozen/v3.json.

selector.primary: holdout: tune:gate (paired t over holdout windows, alpha gate-alpha) of the bar-level selector against SBS = the single member with the best train pnl
selector.secondary: holdout per-period sums and gates; per-window regime selector against SBS; bar-level selector against the best member that trades (best non-flat member on train)

detector.calibrated-on: seed 7, six tapes (P4 grid cut {0.3,0.5,0.7} x k {1,2,4,8,12})
detector.truth: after-the-fact label of every 40-bar segment: efficiency ratio of the whole segment below label-er-cut -> noise, else up/down by the sign of the net move; a change is a segment whose label differs from the previous one

costs.basis: FXCM Standard account is spread-only (no commission). 2026 third-party measurements of its EUR/USD average spread: 0.87 pips (compareforexbrokers, Oct 2026), 1.08 pips (brokersprofile, live FCA account, Apr-May 2026), 1.2 pips (brokeranalysis), 1.30 pips (fxlists). The check uses the high end, 1.3 pips, paid as half-spread on every fill around the Dukascopy bid/ask mid. Lot: 10,000 EUR (one FXCM mini lot), pnl in USD. For reference only, the Dukascopy hourly-close bid/ask spread on the train range (2019-2023) has median 0.3 and mean 0.52 pips (interbank ECN level), well below what a retail Standard account pays.

data.bar: one hour, close; price = (bid close + ask close) / 2; hours with zero bid volume (market closed) are dropped
data.downloaded: 2026-11-16 (Asia/Shanghai); only row counts and the train-range spread were looked at before the freeze

split.rule: tapes are consecutive 320-bar chunks inside each range (a partial last chunk is dropped, no tape crosses the split); window 0 of each tape is warm-up, windows 1-7 are used
